title: The nascent transcriptome delineates the regulatory landscape in human health and disease.
authors: Shah, Sagar R; Chen, You; Leung, Alden K; Navarro, Priscila V Castilho; Paramo, Mauricio I; Gupta, Juhi; Gurumurthy, Aishwarya; Fite, Rebuma F; Weimer, Annika K; Cochran, Kelly; Wang, Austin; Du, Qian; Mohyeldin, Ahmed M; Egli, Dieter; Kundaje, Anshul; Creusot, Remi J; Ryan, Russell J H; Snyder, Michael P; Clark, Andrew G; Lis, John T; Yu, Haiyuan
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文利用PRO-cap构建人类转录调控元件图谱，并结合ProCapNet深度学习模型解析转录起始与TF使用，虽涉及TF-DNA调控但核心是转录组图谱而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Transcriptional regulatory elements (TREs) orchestrate gene expression programs fundamental to cellular identity and transitions across physiological and pathological states. Here, we present a high-resolution atlas of RNA Polymerase II-engaged TREs (enhancers and promoters) across all major human organ systems and a broad spectrum of developmental and disease states. This atlas is generated using PRO-cap, a highly sensitive method that detects nascent RNA at transcription initiation sites, a critical feature of active TREs. The base-pair resolution of PRO-cap enables systematic dissection of transcription initiation architecture, revealing associations among tissue specificity, evolutionary constraint, transcription factor usage, and regulatory connectivity. Integration with deep learning models such as ProCapNet further provides a framework for prioritizing noncoding variants from GWAS and eQTL studies. Moreover, this tissue-resolved atlas identifies lineage-specific regulatory programs and their alterations in diseases such as metastatic cancer, where TRE landscapes capture regulatory signatures reflecting both tissue of origin and adaptive responses to distant niches. Together, these findings establish transcription initiation at regulatory elements as a defining and mechanistically informative layer of gene regulation across development, physiology, and disease.
abstract_zh: 转录调控元件（TREs）协调基因表达程序，这些程序对细胞身份及生理和病理状态间的转变至关重要。在此，我们呈现了一个高分辨率的RNA聚合酶II参与的TREs（增强子和启动子）图谱，覆盖所有主要人体器官系统及广泛的发育和疾病状态。该图谱通过PRO-cap生成，这是一种高度灵敏的方法，可在转录起始位点检测新生RNA，这是活性TREs的关键特征。PRO-cap的碱基对分辨率使得能够系统解析转录起始架构，揭示组织特异性、进化约束、转录因子使用及调控连接性之间的关联。与深度学习模型（如ProCapNet）的整合进一步为从GWAS和eQTL研究中优先排序非编码变异提供了框架。此外，这一组织解析图谱识别了谱系特异性调控程序及其在转移性癌症等疾病中的改变，其中TRE景观捕获了反映组织来源和对远处微环境适应性反应的调控特征。总之，这些发现确立了调控元件处的转录起始作为基因调控的一个定义性且机制信息丰富的层面，贯穿发育、生理和疾病过程。
